name: levea-ai-video-editor
description: AI video editor for Hermes — autonomous, agentic video editing from natural-language prompts: viral clips, animated captions, 9:16 vertical reframe for TikTok / YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels, chroma key, audio cleanup, motion tracking, B-roll, multicam podcast editing, voiceover, music, color grading, motion graphics, MP4 export. Connects to the hosted Levea MCP server (Streamable HTTP); `npx -y levea-mcp-server` over stdio is the fallback.
